well_summary: The NORTHERN HAWK KERROBERT 2-27-32-23 well was spud on November 30, 2025 at 17:00 hours and reached a total depth of 888.00m on December 03, 2025 at 07:39 hours. The well is a vertical well and targeted the WASECA .

The drilling contractor was Precision Drilling and Mostar provided directional services. Geological supervision was provided by Dennis Huntley, P.L. (Geo) and Kurtis Ball B.Sc on behalf of Chinook Consulting Services.

The well was drilled from surface location 2-27-032-23W3. Surface coordinates were 325.0m North of South, 545.1m West of East boundary of section 2-32-23W3, situated at a ground level elevation of 700.70m (Reference: Sea Level). Bottomhole coordinates were 573.36m South of North, 484.25m East of West boundary of Sec 27 at a true vertical depth (TVD) of 883.35m from kelly bushing (705.20m). Total depth was reached at 888.0m, in the TORQUAY.
An main hole was drilled with polymer mud from 99.0m to 888.0m.

The main hole was drilled with polymer mud from 99.0m to 888.0m using 3 bits of 159.0mm with a cumulated drill time of 7.75 hours. A production casing consisting of 73.0mm, type J55, 9.67(kg/m) set at 888.00m was subsequently run.
A total of 4 drilling bits were used to drill the well, with a cumulative drill time of 9.25 hours, resulting in an average penetration rate of 95.5m/hr.

Total gas was monitored using a Pason gas detector. Drill cutting samples were collected over the interval 740m-770m, 2.5m intervals1set for Northern Hawk Energy Ltd.  and 590 to 888m & 830-888, 5m intervals, 2 sets. 740 to 770m, 2.5m intervals 2 sets for the SEM.

Cores were cut with Canterrafrom 804.00 to 828.00m. Coring operations started on December 02, 2025 at 12:26 and ended on December 02, 2025 at 22:46. A total of 24.00m were cut and 23.00m (95.83%) were recovered. Total coring time was 10:20 hours.
Wireline logs were not run. MWD Gamma was recorded.

It was encountered at a measured depth of 802.10m (True Vertical Depth 798.03m, Subsea -92.83m). MWD Gamma confirmed the top of the formation at measured depth of 0.00m (True Vertical Depth 0.00m, Subsea m).
